title: File:Sunset at Siebel.jpg
desc:
Sunset clouds reflected in the Siebel building, San Mateo, California.

I like the way the clouds behind the building seem to continue onto the front of the building, because of the reflections from other clouds there.

title: File:See-Through - Flickr - Peter Kaminski.jpg
art: Peter Kaminski from Southern California, USA
desc:
The side of the Siebel building in San Mateo, California.
The light is just right at dusk, balanced with the inside lights, to make a neat see-through illusion, enhanced by the reflections of the facets of the building on the adjacent facets.
